definitions.gloss: slight bow; nod of acknowledgment; greeting nod
definitions.explanation: A light, quick bow or nod of the head used as a casual greeting, acknowledgment, or sign of politeness. Less formal than a full bow (お辞儀).

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧{会釈|えしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{会釈|えしゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ran into a teacher in the hallway, so I nodded in greeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会釈|えしゃく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧。
examples.english: He walked right past without even a nod.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{会釈|えしゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning "to nod, to give a slight bow."

USAGE:
{会釈|えしゃく} is a brief, casual bow — just a quick dip of the head. It is appropriate when passing acquaintances in hallways, acknowledging someone from a distance, or offering a polite gesture without stopping for a full greeting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{会釈|えしゃく} (slight nod) vs. ⟦お{辞儀|じぎ}→お辞儀：00330_ojigi⟧ (formal bow) — {会釈|えしゃく} is lighter and more casual, while ⟦お{辞儀|じぎ}→お辞儀：00330_ojigi⟧ involves bending at the waist.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧{会釈|えしゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give a light nod)
- {会釈|えしゃく}もしない (to not even nod; to be rude)
